title: Earth Is Not a Perfect Sphere
post_title: Earth Is Not a Perfect Sphere | QuantaTale
post_description: Earth looks like a ball from space, but it is slightly squashed and uneven. Discover the science behind it. Sources: https://oceanservice.noaa.gov/facts/earth-round.html https://nweb.ngs.noaa.gov/research/geopotential-datums/geopotential-surface.shtml #Science #ScienceFacts #Education #QuantaTale
narration: Earth is not a perfect sphere. Its rotation makes the planet bulge around the equator, so the equatorial diameter is larger than the distance through the poles. Scientists describe a useful approximation as an oblate ellipsoid. But even that is not the whole story: mountains, ocean trenches and variations in gravity make Earth's real shape irregular. Geodesists measure these details to map positions and understand our changing planet.
